import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
import os,pathlib,json,subprocess,time,hashlib,re
P=pathlib.Path;win=os.name=='nt';host='windows' if win else 'linux'
fd_limits=None
if not win:
 import resource
 previous=resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)
 resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(min(65536,previous[1]),previous[1]))
 fd_limits={'inherited':list(previous),'effective':list(resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE))}
repo=P('<repo>' if win else '<repo>')
base=P('<artifacts>' if win else '<artifacts>');work=base/'work/local-validation';root=base/'build'/host;target=root/'validation';scratch=root/'validation-tmp';native=base/'deps'/('native-'+host)/'install'
for p in (target,scratch):p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
tc=repo/'toolchains/installed'/('windows-gnu' if win else 'linux')/'bin';suffix='.exe' if win else '';cargo=tc/('cargo'+suffix)
env=dict(os.environ)
for k in ['RUSTFLAGS','CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS','RUSTC_WRAPPER','RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER','CARGO_BUILD_TARGET','RUSTDOCFLAGS','CFLAGS','CXXFLAGS']:env.pop(k,None)
env.update(CARGO=str(cargo),RUSTC=str(tc/('rustc'+suffix)),RUSTDOC=str(tc/('rustdoc'+suffix)),RUSTFMT=str(tc/('rustfmt'+suffix)),CLIPPY_DRIVER=str(tc/('clippy-driver'+suffix)),CARGO_HOME='<cargo-cache>' if win else '<cargo-cache>',CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target),CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2',CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0',CARGO_NET_OFFLINE='true',CARGO_CACHE_AUTO_CLEAN_FREQUENCY='never',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',RUST_TEST_THREADS='2',RUST_TEST_NOCAPTURE='1',TMPDIR=str(scratch),TMP=str(scratch),TEMP=str(scratch),ARIAX_BT_NATIVE_DIR=str(native),ARIAX_BT_SANITIZER='none',OPENSSL_DIR=str(native),OPENSSL_STATIC='1',CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL='1')
if win:env.update(CC='gcc.exe',CXX='g++.exe',AR='ar.exe',ARIAX_REQUIRE_WINDOWS_REPARSE_TEST='1')
else:
 env['PATH']=str(tc)+os.pathsep+env['PATH'];env['CARGO_TARGET_X86_64_UNKNOWN_LINUX_GNU_RUNNER']=str(work/'run-test.sh')
record=work/(host+'-checks.json');rows=json.loads(record.read_text()) if record.exists() else []
def run(name,args,extra=None,timeout=2400):
 if any(r['name']==name and r['exitCode']==0 for r in rows):return
 attempt=1+sum(r['name']==name for r in rows);log=work/(host+'-'+name+'-'+str(attempt)+'.log');selected=dict(env);selected.update(extra or {})
 print(host,'starting',name,'attempt',attempt,flush=True);start=time.monotonic();command=list(map(str,args))
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--binary'],cwd=repo)

import sys,os,pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib,shutil
P=pathlib.Path;win=os.name=='nt';repo=P('<repo>' if win else '<repo>');base=P('<artifacts>' if win else '<artifacts>');host='windows' if win else 'linux';work=base/'deps'/('native-'+host);prefix=work/'install'
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'scripts'));import bt_native as b
m=json.loads((prefix/'ariax-native.json').read_text());old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:native/libtorrent/sources.json'],cwd=repo));current=json.loads(b.SPEC.read_text())
assert old['openssl']==current['openssl']
expected={key:hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+name],cwd=repo)).hexdigest() for key,name in [('sourcesSha256','native/libtorrent/sources.json'),('patchSha256','native/libtorrent/ariax.patch'),('opensslPatchSha256','native/libtorrent/openssl.patch'),('builderSha256','scripts/bt_native.py')]}
expected.update(sanitizer='none',releasePaths=m['inputs']['releasePaths']);b.verify_manifest(prefix,m['target'],expected)
assert b.digest(repo/'scripts/bt_native.py')==expected['builderSha256']
assert b.digest(b.OPENSSL_PATCH)==expected['opensslPatchSha256']
ssl=work/'openssl-install';assert not ssl.exists();ssl.mkdir()
selected={n:h for n,h in m['files'].items() if n.startswith(('include/openssl/','lib/cmake/OpenSSL/')) or n in ('lib/libssl.a','lib/libcrypto.a','lib/pkgconfig/libssl.pc','lib/pkgconfig/libcrypto.pc','lib/pkgconfig/openssl.pc')}
assert 'lib/libssl.a' in selected and 'lib/libcrypto.a' in selected
for n,h in selected.items():
 p=ssl/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(prefix/n,p);assert b.digest(p)==h
source=work/'openssl-source';source.mkdir(exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(prefix/'licenses/openssl.txt',source/'LICENSE.txt')
inputs={'source':current['openssl']['sha256'],'builder':expected['builderSha256'],'patch':expected['opensslPatchSha256'],'target':m['target'],'sanitizer':'none','releasePaths':expected['releasePaths']}
files=b.inventory(ssl);assert files==selected
(work/'openssl-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs':inputs,'files':files})+'\n')
(base/'work/local-validation'/(host+'-openssl-reuse.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'originalNativeManifestSha256':b.digest(prefix/'ariax-native.json'),'unchangedInputs':inputs,'verifiedFiles':selected,'licenseSha256':b.digest(source/'LICENSE.txt'),'purpose':'Materialize verified unchanged OpenSSL cache outputs for the native builder; only the libtorrent patch changes.'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Verified and reused',len(files),'unchanged OpenSSL files')

set breakpoint pending on
set $seen = 0
break RtlRaiseException
commands
silent
